methodology.criticalRule: Two Tier-1 alerts plus one Tier-2 alert in the same monitoring window.
methodology.gpuPrice: Capacity-weighted median GPU-only hourly ask across verified, rentable, unrented, on-demand Vast.ai machines. Hosts are deduplicated and represented by their largest rentable bundle.
methodology.limitations: Offer asks are not completed rentals or utilization. Missing observations remain unavailable and are never treated as healthy.

summary: Oracle's capex burden is elevated, while lab secondary marks and the available GPU baseline do not trigger the locked cross-tier rule.
